subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should the repository accept these 14 third-party action revisions together after an exact-head validation run and secops review?
rationale: The patch is mechanically sound, but it changes executable supply-chain inputs across workflows with tokens, secrets, publication rights, and security-event permissions; only repository owners can accept that trust-boundary update.

options.title: Approve after exact-head review
options.body: Rebase, verify every SHA against its stated upstream tag, obtain secops approval, and require the relevant workflow checks to pass on the final head.

options.title: Split sensitive action families
options.body: Separate token, CodeQL, Docker publishing, and Codex-action changes from routine setup and labeling updates to reduce review blast radius.

options.title: Pause the grouped update
options.body: Keep the PR open without merging if any upstream revision or credential-bearing workflow cannot be confidently validated.

recommendation.title: Approve after exact-head review
recommendation.body: Rebase, verify every SHA against its stated upstream tag, obtain secops approval, and require the relevant workflow checks to pass on the final head.

likelyOwner.reason: This team is the explicit CODEOWNER for several changed security-sensitive workflows and is best placed to accept the supply-chain boundary change.
